strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Software ya bakashitisha no kushitisha mu motoka
strings.tierB.home.description: Software ya kwakanya ifipe: ama invoisi na ama lisiti pa foni ya kashitisha, sitoko ya motoka, indalama, inshila no kutandalila. Ibomba ukwabula intaneti.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Tungululeni bakashitisha benu ukufuma pa kutandalila kwa ntanshi ukufika pa kulipila kwa kulekelesha
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales ni platform ya cloud iya makampani ayakanya ifipe na ayashitisha ifingi (wholesale) ayakwata bakashitisha abatandalila bakasitoma. Bakashitisha balapanga no kupulinta ama invoisi na ama lisiti ukubomfya foni yabo, balakonka sitoko ya motoka no kulemba ukutandalila, ilyo bamaneja balemona ifyashitishiwa, indalama ishalonganikwa ne fyo bakasitoma bashalako ukulipila apo pene.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Ama invoisi ukufuma pa foni ya kashitisha
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Kashitisha alapanga invoisi ali kuli kasitoma no kuipulinta pa pulinta ya thermal iya Bluetooth ilyo talafuma mu shitolo.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Ukulonganika indalama ne fyo bakasitoma bashalako
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Lyonse ilyo kasitoma alipila, alapeelwa lisiti iyakwata nambala iyalundwa ku ma invoisi ayo alelipila, kabili ifyo ashalako na sitetimenti yakwe filaalulwa apo pene.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Sitoko ya motoka iyo kashitisha asunga
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Sitoko ya cila motoka ilakonkwa icintu ku cintu: ifyaingishiwa, ifyashitishiwa, ifyabweshiwa ne fyashalapo, pa kuti ukupusana konse kumoneke pa bushiku bwine bulya.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Inshila no kutandalila
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Ukutandalila kulalembwa ne ncende, inshita ne fikope, kabili inshila ya cila kashitisha ilalangishiwa pa mapu pa kuti maneja aimone.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Ibomba ukwabula intaneti
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Bakashitisha balatwalilila ukushitisha nangu tapali netiweki. Ifyalembwa filalolela pa foni, lyena filatumwa fyeka ilyo intaneti yabwela, kabili cila calembwa cilafika umuku umo fye.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Dashboard ya pa webu iya bamaneja
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Ifyashitishiwa, indalama ishalonganikwa, ifyabweshiwa, sitoko ne fyo bakashitisha babomba pa ncende imo, pamo ne fyo cila muntu uubomfya FieldSales engacita ukulingana ne cifulo cakwe.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Tweebeni ifyo mushitishamo
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Lombeni kotesheni nelyo sungeni inshita ya kukumana. Tulalolesha bakashitisha benu, inshila, ifipe fyenu ne fyo mulefwaya pa ma invoisi.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Pekanyeni kampani yenu
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Bikenimo ifipe, imitengo, bakasitoma na bakashitisha, kabili bikeni indalama no musonko wa calo cenu mu ma settings.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Tumeni bakashitisha mu nshila
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Bakashitisha babika app pa Android nelyo iPhone, baingisha ifipe mu motoka yabo kabili batendeka ukushitisha, ukupulinta no kulonganika indalama.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Konkeni ubushiku ilyo bulecitika
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Dashboard ya pa webu ilangisha ifyashitishiwa, indalama ishalonganikwa, sitoko ya mamotoka no kutandalila ilyo bakashitisha bacili mu nshila.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales ni platform ya cloud iya kutungulula bakashitisha abatandalila bakasitoma mu makampani ayakanya ifipe na ayashitisha ifingi. Ibikamo ukushitisha ukufuma mu motoka (van sales), ukushitisha mu nshila ishapekanishiwa (route sales), ukupoka ama oda libela (pre-sales) no kutwala ifipe ku mashitolo ukwabula ukupitila kumbi (DSD). Bakashitisha balapanga ama invoisi, balapulinta, balalonganika indalama no kulemba ukutandalila ukubomfya foni yabo, kabili bamaneja balakonka ifyashitishiwa, indalama, sitoko ya mamotoka ne fyo bakasitoma bashalako pa dashboard ya pa webu.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Ee. App ya kashitisha ilatwalilila ukubomba ukwabula intaneti: bakashitisha balapanga no kupulinta ama invoisi na ama lisiti, balalemba ukutandalila no kulundako bakasitoma abapya. Ilyo intaneti yabwela, fyonse filatumwa fyeka, kabili cila calembwa cilafika umuku umo fye. Kwaliba ukupusana kumo ku Saudi Arabia: amakampani ayaisula ukulunda kwa ma invoisi ya pa intaneti yalakabila intaneti pa nshita ya kupanga invoisi nelyo icalembwa ca fipe ifyabweshiwa.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales ibombela amakampani ayakanya ifipe mu fyalo fyonse. Cila kampani ibika indalama yayo no musonko mu ma settings yayo, kabili ama invoisi, ama lisiti na ama lipoti yalabomfya iyo ndalama na uyo musonko. Ofesi ya FieldSales ili ku Riyadh, ku Saudi Arabia, kabili ukutendeka kucitwa pa intaneti ukupitila mu kukumana, pa WhatsApp no bwafwilisho ukufuma ukutali.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: Bushe FieldSales ilalunda ku nshila sha buteko isha ma invoisi ya pa intaneti?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Tulaafwilisha ukulunda kwa Cipande ca Cibili ku platform ya Fatoora iya ZATCA. Ici cilabomba ku makampani ya ku Saudi Arabia. Mu fyalo fimbi, FieldSales ipanga ama invoisi ne ndalama yenu no musonko wenu, kabili ukulunda ku nshila ya calo iya ma invoisi ya pa intaneti (e-invoicing) kulasangwa nga mwalomba, panuma ya kuti twalolesha pamo naimwe ifyo calo cilya cifwaya. Kunse ya Saudi Arabia, tatulaya ukuti FieldSales ilakonka amafunde ya ma invoisi ya pa intaneti aya fyalo fimbi.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: App ya FieldSales ilasangwa mu ndimi nshi?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: App ya FieldSales ilasangwa mu ndimi shino fye: Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese. Taisangwa mu Cibemba. Bakashitisha na bamaneja kuti baalula ululimi lwa app, kabili ama invoisi ayapulintwa kuti yakwata ululimi lwa cibili ku mbali ya lulimi ulukalamba. Amapeji ya website mu ndimi shimbi, nga ipeji lino lya Cibemba, ni mapeji ayapilibulwa fye pa kupeela ukwishiba pali iyi software.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Lombeni kotesheni, sungeni inshita ya kukumana nelyo mututumine ilyashi pa WhatsApp. Tusambilila ifyo bakashitisha benu babomba, lyena tulamwafwa ukupekanya ifipe, imitengo, bakasitoma na bakashitisha. Bakashitisha babika app pa Android nelyo iPhone, kabili bamaneja babomfya dashboard ya pa webu pa browser iili yonse. Ifya kubomfya ifyo mukabila ni ma smartphone fye.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: App ya FieldSales ilasangwa mu ndimi shino: Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese; taisangwa mu Cibemba. Amapeji mu ndimi shimbi yalondolola software pa kumupeela ukwishiba fye.
strings.tierB.category.title: Software ya kushitisha mu motoka (van sales) | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Software ya kushitisha mu motoka (van sales): ama invoisi ayapulintwa ukufuma pa foni, sitoko ya motoka, indalama no kutandalila. Ibomba ukwabula intaneti.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Software ya kushitisha mu motoka iya makampani ayakanya ifipe na aya wholesale
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales ni software ya kushitisha mu motoka iya makampani ayakwata bakashitisha abashitisha ukufuma mu motoka mu nshila sha cila bushiku. Kashitisha aingisha ifipe mu motoka, ashitisha pa cila shitolo, apulinta invoisi, alonganika indalama no kulemba ifyabweshiwa, fyonse pa app imo iya foni. Maneja alamona ifyaingishiwa, ifyashitishiwa, indalama ishalonganikwa ne fyashalapo mu cila motoka.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Software ya kushitisha mu motoka cinshi?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Software ya kushitisha mu motoka, nelyo software ya route sales, ibomfiwa mu nshila ya kushitisha umo kashitisha asenda sitoko mu motoka kabili ashitisha, atwala ifipe, apanga invoisi no kulonganika indalama pa kutandalila kumo. Ipyana ama buku ya ma invoisi aya mapepala no kwitana pa foni ku kupwa kwa bushiku. Ilemba cila cashitishiwa, cila kulipila na cila cabweshiwa nge calembwa, pa kuti sitoko ne ndalama filinganishiwe pa bushiku bwine bulya. Kuli maneja, ilaasuka amepusho yatatu cila cungulo: cila kashitisha ashitisha cinshi, alonganika indalama shinga, kabili cinshi cashala mu cila motoka?
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Ubushiku mu nshila
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Ubushiku butendeka no kwingisha ifipe ifyalembwa ukufuma mu ng'anda ya kusungilamo ifipe ukuya mu motoka. Pa cila shitolo kashitisha asala kasitoma mu app, alundako ifipe ukufuma pa lisitu nelyo pa barcode, apanga invoisi no kuipulinta pa pulinta ya thermal. Ukulipila kulalembwa ne lisiti, kabili cila cabweshiwa cilalembwa pamo no mulandu wa kubwesha. Ku kupwa kwa bushiku, ifyashalapo mu motoka filabweshiwa ku ng'anda ya kusungilamo ifipe. Ilyo ifi fyonse filecitika, maneja kuti akonka ifyashitishiwa, indalama no kutandalila kwa cila kashitisha pa dashboard ya pa webu ukwabula ukwitana uli onse pa foni.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Yapangilwa incende ishaba ne netiweki iyanaka
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Inshila sha kwakanya ifipe shipita mu fikuulwa ifya pe samba lya mushili, mu ncende sha mafakitale na mu mishi umo netiweki yanaka. App ya kashitisha iya FieldSales isunga bakasitoma, ifipe ne mitengo pa foni, e calenga kashitisha kuti apanga no kupulinta ifyalembwa ukwabula intaneti. Cila calembwa cakwata nambala yaco iyapusana, e calenga cilafika umuku umo fye, nangu ukutuma kwabwekeshiwapo. Amakampani ya ku Saudi Arabia ayaisula ukulunda kwa ma invoisi ya pa intaneti yalakabila intaneti pa nshita ya kupanga ama invoisi ne fyalembwa fya fipe ifyabweshiwa. Kuli ayo makampani, ukupanga ama lisiti, ukulemba ukutandalila no kulundako bakasitoma abapya filabomba fye ukwabula intaneti.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Ukulonganika indalama ne sitoko ya motoka
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Indalama ishili mu nshila shilefwaya ukulolekeshiwa nga filya sitoko ilolekeshiwa. Lyonse ilyo kasitoma alipila, alapeelwa lisiti iyakwata nambala iyo bengalunda ku ma invoisi ayo alelipila, kabili ifyo ashalako filaalulwa apo pene. Sitoko ya motoka ipendwa icintu ku cintu: ifyaingishiwa ukufumyamo ifyashitishiwa, ukulundako ifyabweshiwa ne fyalungikwa ifyalembwa, e calenga bamaneja kuti bailinganya no kupenda kwa cine ilyo kashitisha talaya ku ng'anda. Ifyabweshiwa kuti fyabikwa mu misango itatu: ifyaseeka, ifyonaika nelyo ifya kwalulana, kabili maneja e upingula nga fingabwela muli sitoko ya motoka iyapekanishiwa ukushitishiwa.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Yalinga bani?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales yalinga amakampani ayakanya ifipe na aya wholesale aya fipe ifishitishiwa bwangu (FMCG) nga ifyakulya, ifyakunwa, ifya kusukila ne fya kusunga umubili, na kampani iili yonse iyakwata bakashitisha abatandalila amashitolo, ama tuck shop ne fishitolo ifinono mu nshila ishapekanishiwa. Ilaafwilisha ukushitisha mu motoka, ama oda ya libela (pre-sales) no kutwala ifipe ku mashitolo ukwabula ukupitila kumbi (DSD). Te ERP iyabikamo fyonse: ilalunda ku nshila yenu iya accounting nelyo ERP ukupitila mu API. Bamaneja balateka ifyo cila kashitisha engacita, nga ukupeela discount, ukushitisha pa mutengo uwanono ukucila uwa pa lisitu nelyo ukulundako bakasitoma abapya.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Kupusana nshi ukwaba pa kati ka kushitisha mu motoka na pre-sales?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Mu kushitisha mu motoka kashitisha asenda sitoko kabili atwala ifipe, apanga invoisi no kulonganika indalama pa kutandalila kumo. Mu pre-sales kashitisha apoka oda iyo ing'anda ya kusungilamo ifipe ikatwala panuma. FieldSales ilaafwilisha inshila shonse shibili, e calenga kampani kuti yabomfya amamotoka mu nshila shimo no kupoka ama oda mu shimbi. Muli shonse shibili, ama invoisi, indalama ne fyo bakasitoma bashalako fili mu nshila imo, kabili bamaneja balafimona mu ma lipoti yamo yene.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Bushe ndinganya shani sitoko ya motoka ku kupwa kwa bushiku?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales ilangisha, pa cila cintu mu cila motoka, ubwingi ubwaingishiwa, ubwashitishiwa, ubwabweshiwa ne bwashalapo. Linganyeni ifyashalapo no kupenda kwa cine, lembeni ukupusana konse ngo kulungika ukwalembwa, lyena bwesheni ifyashalapo ku ng'anda ya kusungilamo ifipe umuku umo. Motoka itendeka ubushiku bukonkapo ne sitoko iyalungama kabili iyaishibikwa.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Kashitisha uushitisha mu motoka alakabila ifya kubomfya nshi?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Smartphone, Android nelyo iPhone. Pulinta ya thermal iya Bluetooth te ya kupatikisha, kabili ilaafwa kashitisha ukupeela kasitoma invoisi nelyo lisiti iyapulintwa. FieldSales taishitisha ifya kubomfya kabili taifwaya umusango umo fye wa pulinta. Bamaneja babomfya dashboard ya pa webu pa browser ya kompyuta nelyo foni iili yonse.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: Bushe FieldSales kuti yalunda ku nshila yesu iya accounting?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Ee. FieldSales ipeela API iyaafwa inshila yenu iya accounting nelyo ERP ukwakana na platform bakasitoma, ifipe, ama invoisi, ama lisiti no kwenda kwa sitoko. Ibumba lyenu nelyo kampani yenu iya IT ikuula uku kulunda ukubomfya ifyalembwa fya API.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales mu fyalo: indalama, umusonko ne e-invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales ibombela amakampani ayakanya ifipe mu fyalo fyonse. Moneni indalama, umusonko ne fyo e-invoicing yaba mu cila calo pa tebulo limo.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales ibombela amakampani ayakanya ifipe mu fyalo fyonse. Cila kampani isala icalo cayo, indalama no musonko mu ma settings yayo, kabili ama invoisi, ama lisiti na ama lipoti yalakonka ifyo yasala. Ukulunda ku buteko pa ma invoisi ya pa intaneti kulabomba ku Saudi Arabia fye. Mu fyalo fimbi fyonse kulasangwa nga mwalomba. Itebulo ilili pe samba lilangisha, pa cila calo, indalama yaco, umusonko uwaseeka uwa kushitisha nelyo VAT, kabili nga ukulunda ku buteko pa ma invoisi ya pa intaneti kulabomba nelyo kulasangwa nga mwalomba.
strings.tierB.countries.columns.einvoicing: Ama invoisi ya pa intaneti aya buteko
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Tulaafwilisha ukulunda kwa Cipande ca Cibili ku platform ya Fatoora iya ZATCA
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Indalama no musonko fibikwa na cila kampani mu ma settings yayo. Imisonko iili pe tebulo lino ni ya kutungulula fye kabili kuti yaaluka; ipusheni kafwilisha wenu pa musonko pa mafunde ya nomba. Nga mwamona (—) pe tebulo, ninshi tapali umusonko uwaseeka uwalembwa pali cilya calo.
strings.tierB.about.title: Pali FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales ipanga software ya cloud iya makampani ayakanya ifipe ayakwata bakashitisha. FieldSales yatendeke mu 2026 ku Riyadh, ku Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (ishina mu Ciarabu: فيلد سيلز) ni platform ya cloud iya makampani ayakanya ifipe na aya wholesale ayakwata bakashitisha abatandalila bakasitoma. FieldSales yatendeke mu 2026 kabili ofesi yayo ili ku Riyadh, ku Saudi Arabia. Ibombela amakampani mu fyalo fyonse, kabili indalama no musonko wa cila calo fibikwa mu ma settings ya cila kampani. Bakasitoma besu ni makampani ayashitisha no kutwala ifipe ukupitila muli bakashitisha aba mu nshila: abakwakanya ifipe, aba wholesale na abapanga ifipe abakwata bakashitisha babo aba mu mamotoka.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Tukuula inshila imo iyalundana iya mulimo onse uwa mu nshila: ama invoisi ayapulintwa ukufuma pa foni ya kashitisha, ama lisiti ne fyo bakasitoma bashalako, sitoko ya motoka iyo kashitisha asunga, inshila no kutandalila pamo ne ncende ne fikope, na dashboard ya pa webu iya bamaneja. App ya kashitisha ibomba pa Android na iPhone kabili itwalilila ukubomba ukwabula intaneti, lyena ilatuma fyonse ilyo intaneti yabwela. Amakampani kuti yalunda FieldSales ku nshila yabo iya accounting nelyo ERP ukupitila mu API, pa kuti ifyalembwa mu nshila fileke ukulembwa imiku ibili.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Tulondolola software nga fintu ili. Tulaafwilisha ukulunda kwa Cipande ca Cibili ku platform ya Fatoora iya ZATCA. Ukulunda ku nshila sha buteko mu fyalo fimbi kulasangwa nga mwalomba. App ilasangwa mu ndimi shino: Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese; taisangwa mu Cibemba. Pa kulanshanya naifwe, lombeni kotesheni, sungeni inshita ya kukumana nelyo mututumine ilyashi pa WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Lanshanyeni na FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Lanshanyeni ne bumba lya FieldSales: lombeni kotesheni, sungeni inshita ya kukumana nelyo tulanshanye pa WhatsApp pa software ya kushitisha mu motoka.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Tweebeni ifyo bakashitisha benu bashitisha lelo ne fyo mulefwaya ukwalula. Lombeni kotesheni, sungeni inshita ya kukumana nelyo mututumine ilyashi pa WhatsApp, kabili umo pa bumba lyesu akamwasuka. Amakampani ayabomfya kale FieldSales kuti yabomfya inshila shimo shine pa kusanga ubwafwilisho. Cilaafwa ukulanda icalo cenu, impendwa ya bakashitisha, na nga bashitisha ukufuma mu mamotoka, bapoka ama oda nelyo fyonse fibili.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Sungeni inshita ya kukumana pa intaneti ne bumba lyesu. Tukamulanga ubushiku bwa kashitisha mu app na pa dashboard ya maneja, ukubomfya ifya kumwenako ifipalana ne fipe ne nshila fyenu, kabili tukaasuka amepusho yenu pa kupekanya.
